title: Repeat Donor Interval Trend
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:donation donation_type=* interval_days=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(interval_days) as metric by _time donation_type
| sort 0 _time donation_type
description: Trends monthly repeat-donation interval days by donation type for donation cadence.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether donation cadence are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `donation_type` on `community:donation` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly repeat-donation interval days.
visualization: Line chart of monthly repeat-donation interval days by donation type.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how repeat-donation interval days changes month by month for each donation type so you can see whether donation cadence are heading the right way.
